title: De'Longhi Magnifica Evo £349, Dyson V8 £229.99 and a heated airer £76
description: Saturday's checked UK deals: a bean-to-cup coffee machine at £230 off, the Dyson V8 at its low, and heated airers and throws for colder nights.
intro:
**Today's standout is the De'Longhi Magnifica Evo with automatic milk at £349 from Very, £230 less than AO charges for the same machine.** Argos has also started its Black Friday sale, and the Dyson V8 Cyclone at £229.99 is effectively at its lowest price. The clocks go back tonight, so we've added three ways to keep warm for less: a heated airer, an electric underblanket and a heated throw.

Buy now or wait? The coffee machine and the Dyson are good prices now, and Very will refund the difference if its price drops before 4 December. The toothbrush and air fryer have both been cheaper recently, so they're fine but not urgent.

deals.name: De'Longhi Magnifica Evo bean-to-cup with LatteCrema (ECAM290.83.TB)
deals.note: Makes lattes and cappuccinos at the touch of a button. The 'was' price is genuine: AO still charges £579. Compare it with the rest in our new [coffee machine Black Friday guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Dyson V8 Cyclone Cordless Vacuum with Furniture Cleaning Kit
deals.note: Within pennies of its three-month low and about £120 under AO and Currys. Ignore Argos's 'was £379.99'; £349 is the real comparison. See our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Dunelm 3 Tier Heated Airer
deals.note: Dries a full load indoors for a few pence an hour, far less than a tumble dryer. 20% off Dunelm's usual price.

deals.name: Silentnight Comfort Control Electric Underblanket, Double
deals.note: Warming the bed costs pennies a night compared with heating the bedroom. Not the lowest it's been (about £17.50), but a fair price for a trusted brand. Delivered by the supplier in 3–5 days.

deals.name: Dreamland Snuggle Up Warming Throw, Black (120x160cm)
deals.note: A heated throw for the sofa so you can turn the thermostat down. Around £60 is a normal sale price for Dreamland throws.

deals.name: De'Longhi Stilosa manual espresso machine (EC260BK)
deals.note: A cheap way to try espresso at home, with a steam wand for milk. About £10 less than at John Lewis and Currys.

deals.name: Tefal Easy Fry Mega 7.5L Air Fryer (EY855D40)
deals.note: A big single drawer that fits a whole chicken. It's been as low as £68, so this is fair rather than a record. More in our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Oral-B iO2 Electric Toothbrush (Night Black)
deals.note: The cheapest of the big retailers today, but it's dipped under £30 recently. Our refreshed [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/) has the target prices.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

For the Magnifica Evo and the Dyson V8, no: both are at or near the best prices we've seen. For Sage and Ninja coffee machines, PS5 consoles and the cheaper Oral-B brushes, last year's Black Friday prices were lower, so hold off. Our refreshed [PS5 Black Friday guide](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/) has today's console prices, and every brand guide is on the [Black Friday hub](/black-friday/).

## Keep warm for less

Three of today's picks come from this week's [keep warm for less spotlight](/spotlight/keep-warm-for-less-winter-2026/), which compares running costs for blankets, throws, airers and heaters, with the prices worth paying.
